paragraphs: To prepare students to succeed in the PHYS 143 examination through conceptual understanding, technical competence and application to unfamiliar problems.

Each week is taught in three contacts. Every lecture provides a slide deck, a tutorial sheet and a supplementary note. All files are PDF. Each lecture page also has its own twenty multiple-choice practice questions, which run in the browser, for practice and not assessment.
after: **Weekly routine:** attend all three contacts, attempt the tutorial before the answers, review the supplementary note, and use the deck checklist to find gaps.

bottom.heading: Why This Course Matters: Research-Informed Learning
bottom.subtitle: How foundational physics connects to modern research.

cards.title: Vectors and nuclear reaction kinematics
paragraphs: The vector methods of Level 100 describe how momentum and energy are shared among the products of a nuclear reaction.

cards.title: Statistics and uncertainty quantification
paragraphs: Measurement uncertainty, fitting and model comparison are the same ideas used to constrain the parameters of nuclear models.

cards.title: Differential equations and reaction dynamics
paragraphs: Equations of motion with random forces, the Langevin equations, describe how a heavy nuclear system evolves during a reaction.

cards.title: Programming and physical models
paragraphs: Scientific computing turns a physical model into numbers that can be compared with experiment, as in the KEWPIE codes.
